watches.name: ChronoAstra Lunar Eclipse
watches.description: Light held inside shadow. Lunar Eclipse sets an ultra-white, stone-like enamel dial within black DLC Grade 5 titanium. It is the collection's most graphic contrast: moonlight contained by a dark, hand-finished horizon.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Aurora test
watches.description: Create a one-of-one titanium watch with a custom star map from your chosen date, time and location. Explore ChronoAstra's celestial timepieces.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Reservation
watches.description: Refundable €99 reservation towards a made-to-order ChronoAstra watch. The €99 is credited once against your final watch price and is refundable while the reservation is incomplete.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Lunar Eclipse Build
watches.description: Black DLC Grade 5 titanium case with a White Dwarf enamel starmap dial. Configured on build.chronoastra.com — the caseback engraving coordinates, date, time and personal text are recorded on the line item. Made to order — please read before choosing a shipping option: every watch is built for you after ordering. Production takes approximately 3.5 months when the case and dial are in stock, and 6 months when the configuration is sold out and enters the next production run. Any shipping method chosen at checkout applies only to the transit time after your watch is finished — it does not shorten production. Free premium worldwide shipping (duties & VAT paid) is included.

watches.description: ChronoAstra x Sandry Riffard, pure 24K gold stained glass enamel dial with hand placed 24K gold wire. One of twenty five pieces. Made to order, estimated delivery Q2 2027. Each piece is individually commissioned and made one of one for you right after payment, therefore final sale and non refundable. Worldwide shipping, duties and taxes included. Ships with both straps: black FKM strap and titanium bracelet. The titanium bracelet is finished to match your chosen case, black or silver Grade 5 titanium. Grade 5 titanium case, Swiss made modified La Joux-Perret G101 movement, engraved caseback. Your palette, case finish, strap and caseback selections are recorded with your order.

watches.name: ChronoAstra White Dwarf
watches.description: Light, condensed. White Dwarf turns your night sky into an exercise in light. An ultra-white enamel dial with subtle stone-like visual depth sits inside hand-finished natural titanium, allowing the personalized constellation map to emerge with quiet, tonal precision.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Midnight Aurora
watches.description: Blue fire after dark. Midnight Aurora places the moving brilliance of blue aventurine inside a hand-finished black DLC Grade 5 titanium case. The case recedes; the dial appears to illuminate itself.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Aurora
watches.description: A night sky caught in motion. Aurora pairs a deep blue aventurine dial with hand-finished natural Grade 5 titanium. Your exact sky appears over a field that shifts from midnight blue to electric starlight as the wrist moves: cool, luminous and unmistakably alive.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Starlight
watches.description: The night, edged in light. Starlight surrounds a black aventurine sky with hand-finished natural Grade 5 titanium. The dial looks almost still until light finds it. Then a fine field of stars appears beneath your personalized constellations.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Dark Matter
watches.description: The universe in its quietest form. Dark Matter combines black aventurine with black DLC Grade 5 titanium. What first appears monochrome reveals layers of sparkle, graphite, polished black and luminous blue: detail that only exists when light reaches it.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Event Horizon
watches.description: Where light meets absolute black. Event Horizon pairs a near-void ultra-black enamel dial with hand-finished natural Grade 5 titanium. With no aventurine sparkle beneath it, every constellation line appears suspended against pure darkness.

watches.name: ChronoAstra Blackout
watches.description: Darkness, designed for the stars. Blackout is the most uncompromising ChronoAstra: ultra-black enamel inside hand-finished black DLC Grade 5 titanium. The architecture recedes until your one-of-one constellation map appears to exist on its own.
